title: Dinomonkey unban

replies.author: Administrafer
replies.body:
Hello,
Before I begin, you have been banned for exactly 4 months. As it seems you did not know this information, you will be let off the hook.
Now, your punishment has been deemed stale - as it was I, Riskayyy, who punished you originally and cannot recall the situation when you were banned. Therefore you should be able to connect to the Network again! Enjoy!

Thanks.
